# Undivided Allegiance

> Undivided Allegiance is a Christian writing and speaking ministry by Drew Reitzel, calling the American Church to full, undivided allegiance to Jesus Christ. The central conviction: the Church has not drifted from biblical faithfulness — it has chosen to exchange it for cultural approval, and the cost is measured in souls.

## About

Drew Reitzel holds a theology degree and spent 25 years in business before returning to writing and speaking. He is the author of *You Can't Serve Two Masters* (2026) and the founder of Undivided Allegiance. His work is prophetic in tone, pastoral in heart, and rooted in Scripture.

The ministry's core message draws from Matthew 6:24: you cannot give divided loyalty to God and to the world. This is not a political message. It is a call to choose Christ fully, whatever the cost.

## Book

**You Can't Serve Two Masters** by Drew Reitzel
- ISBN: 979-8-2786-09926
- Kindle: $9.99 | Paperback: $16.99
- Available at: https://www.undividedallegiance.com/book/
- The book names what most pastors and Christian authors will not: the American Church is not drifting — it is choosing. It diagnoses the problem with honesty and calls readers back with compassion.

## Newsletter

**The Remnant** — a newsletter for believers who refuse to pretend the Church is fine
- Subscribe at: https://www.undividedallegiance.com/newsletter/
- Biweekly issues covering Scripture, culture, and the cost of undivided allegiance

## Blog Posts

- [The Church Is Not Drifting. It Is Choosing](https://www.undividedallegiance.com/blog/the-church-is-choosing/) — The American Church has not drifted from truth. It has chosen, slowly and deliberately, to exchange biblical faithfulness for cultural approval. (Published March 15, 2026)

- [The God of Comfort vs. the God of Scripture](https://www.undividedallegiance.com/blog/the-god-of-comfort-vs-the-god-of-scripture/) — The American Church has created a God in its own image: one who affirms everything, demands nothing, and exists primarily to make us feel better. (Published February 15, 2026)

- [What Does "You Cannot Serve Two Masters" Really Mean?](https://www.undividedallegiance.com/blog/what-does-you-cannot-serve-two-masters-really-mean/) — We've reduced Matthew 6:24 to a verse about money. Jesus was talking about something far more dangerous. (Published April 8, 2026)

- [What Repentance Actually Requires](https://www.undividedallegiance.com/blog/what-repentance-actually-requires/) — The Church has replaced repentance with self-improvement. The gap between claiming to be Christian and holding a biblical worldview starts here. (Published March 1, 2026)

- [Why Pastors Won't Preach Hard Truths Anymore](https://www.undividedallegiance.com/blog/why-pastors-wont-preach-hard-truths/) — Half of all American pastors feel limited in what they can say from the pulpit. This isn't timidity. It's a calculated choice. (Published April 28, 2026)

- [Why "You Can't Serve Two Masters" Is the Book the American Church Needs Right Now](https://www.undividedallegiance.com/blog/why-you-cant-serve-two-masters-is-the-book-the-church-needs-now/) — The American Church is not drifting. It is choosing. This book names the choice most authors and pastors won't. (Published March 26, 2026)

- [What It Means to Be Double-Minded: James 1:8 and the Crisis of Divided Allegiance](https://www.undividedallegiance.com/blog/double-minded-man-james-1-8/) — The Greek word dipsychos means "two-souled." James 1:8 is not a prayer doubt problem — it is a divided allegiance crisis, confirmed by James 4:4–8. (Published May 8, 2026)
